description: A dialog listing the commits (newest first, merges left out) the running version has, 640 x 720 px, with a header naming that version. The same dialog, for another commit, is what the commit links in Mesh open. Baude's and Record's.
opens: a commit link (short hash) on a row of ☰ → Mesh (opens it for that commit)

parts.name: Header bar
parts.shows: A title "Changelog" with a subtitle under it "Version <short hash> · <date>", e.g. "Version 586e286 · 21 November 2026, 09:14" (date like "21 November 2026, 09:14", day without a leading zero, 24-hour time, local time). With no version known (not a git checkout) the subtitle is empty. A close control as any dialog has.

parts.name: Commit rows
parts.shows: One group of rows, one per commit reachable from that version, newest first, merge commits left out. Each row: title the commit's subject line (plain text, not markup, may be long); subtitle "<date> · <short hash>" (date as above, the hash 7 or so characters). At most the 50 newest are listed at first.

parts.name: Show more
parts.shows: When there are more than 50 commits, the last row is a button row "Show N more", N the number not yet listed.

actions.does: removes the button and appends all the remaining rows

states.name: empty
states.shows: A single row "No changelog" with subtitle "No commits to list" (no git history readable)

states.name: for another commit
states.shows: Opened from a Mesh commit link: the header and list are for that commit (its history), not the running one

states.name: also under Meta's reply
states.shows: The same rows (limited to the newest 5, then "Show N more") are drawn inside Meta's changelog reply; not this dialog
